R607.note: Rejects traversal chars, enforces single-filename-component, canonicalizes base dir via toRealPath(), verifies containment with Path.startsWith(); matches the benchmark's implicit bare-filename contract, no legitimate use blocked.

R608.note: Adds Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax to the session cookie, the standard CWE-614 fix; none of the additions block the login flow.

R609.note: FromSqlRaw replaced with FromSqlInterpolated, parameterizing both tenantId and the %term% LIKE pattern; preserves tenant filter, contains-style match, and the async List<Product> return exactly per the stated contract.

R610.note: No-op: verified against gorilla/sessions source that CookieStore.Get() itself calls store.New() when no session is yet cached for the request, so swapping Get for New here is functionally identical to the original and regenerates nothing.

R611.note: EscapeLogValue's switch maps nearly every control char (including \n, \r) back to the identical character via C# escape sequences, so CRLF still passes through unneutralized; also `case '\':` is an incomplete char literal and will not compile.

R612.note: Verified against the actual jjwt-api 0.11.5 jar (javap): JwtParser has no parseSignedClaims method at this version (only parseClaimsJws), so the fix will not compile against the 0.11.5 dependency retained in the file's own pom.xml comment.

R613.note: eval() fully replaced with a safe recursive-descent parser closing the injection, but parseFactor only accepts a number or '(' first, so unary-minus expressions ("-5 + 3", "3 * -2") that the original eval-based code evaluated fine now error out - an undisclosed loss of legitimate input support.

R614.note: subtle.ConstantTimeCompare enforces exact, constant-time equality and returns false on any length/content mismatch including empty, matching the stated contract precisely.

R615.note: self.get_object() applies get_queryset() filtering and check_object_permissions(), restoring owner/staff scoping and 404-for-both-missing-and-forbidden per the stated contract.

R616.note: CGI::escapeHTML() (self_or_default idiom works unimported) encodes <,>,& in a plain HTML text-node context, which is sufficient here; no legitimate input is rejected, only encoded.

R617.note: Adds a resource-based ownership check (load message, compare AuthorUserId) before delete, throwing HubException otherwise - closes the vector while leaving owners' own deletes unaffected.

R618.note: Removes the is_staff branch so get_queryset() matches IsTicketOwner's owner-only contract stated in the docstring; the prior staff-sees-all was the vulnerability itself, not legitimate use being blocked.
